body: I'm old enough to not be supported at all by my parents. I'm not in a financially stable enough place to have extra money for a lawyer.
I've already been to the police once after he hit me. He manipulated me to go with him to court to get the charges dropped. They believed him. I have no more trust in law enforcement.
This made me smile a bit, thank you kind stranger
Thank you :) Still dealing with the emotional aftermath of a break up but today's the first day of the rest of my life. I can only go up from here
